expected.insightNarrative:
Alliance Page is the home page of the Airline Alliance Activity Dashboard, which follows the activity of the AeroLink alliance of four airlines (Atlantic Express, Global Star, Pacific Wings and SkyConnect Airways) from 2022 to 2025. The year, month and region are selected on the left; the dashboard shows July 2023 for North America. Each KPI card gives the month's value, its change against the previous month, a bar chart of the twelve months of the year with a dot under each month marking whether it beat the same month of the prior year, and a breakdown by airline.

Key insights
- SkyConnect Airways is by far the largest carrier: 1,307 completed flights in the current month and 1,283 in the previous month, far ahead of the other members, with revenue passenger kilometres of 1.78B this month and 1.85B the month before.
- On-time performance for the alliance is 84.4% in the selected month, among the year's highest with 84.5% in March, while April, February and August are the low months at 82.0%, 82.3% and 82.6%. Global Star is the most punctual airline at 94.4% and Pacific Wings the least at 77.3%; SkyConnect Airways' previous-month rate of 82.5% was also low.
- Alliance revenue passenger kilometres were lowest in February at 1.74B. The average CSAT score is 7.9 in the selected month, a high for the year, with February the low at 7.8; Pacific Wings has the lowest CSAT at 7.8 and Atlantic Express scored 7.9 in the previous month.
- New York is the top destination with 278 completed flights this month.
- Among aircraft, the B787 has the highest load factor at 91.1% while the A330 has the lowest at 89.6%; the B777 carried the most passengers in the previous month, 100,328, and the B787 flew the fewest flights that month, 275.
- Baggage mishandling is high at Atlantic Express (91.5% in the previous month) and Pacific Wings (86.7% this month).

Comp Flights BAN, Comp Flights Bars, Comp Flights Circles, Comp Flights Labels, Comp Flights Airlines
Completed flights for the month are 1,688, up 0.7% versus the previous month. SkyConnect Airways completed by far the most flights at 1,307, ahead of Atlantic Express (188), Pacific Wings (105) and Global Star (88).

On Time BAN, On Time Bars, On Time Circles, On Time Labels, On Time Airlines
On-time performance is 84.4%, up 2.3% versus the previous month. Global Star leads at 94.4%, followed by Atlantic Express (84.5%), SkyConnect Airways (84.3%) and Pacific Wings (77.3%).

RPK BAN, RPK Bars, RPK Circles, RPK Labels, RPK Airlines
Revenue passenger kilometres are 2.38 billion km, down 3.8% versus the previous month. SkyConnect Airways accounts for most of them at 1.78 billion km, followed by Global Star (0.32 billion), Atlantic Express (0.22 billion) and Pacific Wings (0.06 billion).

CSAT BAN, CSAT Bars, CSAT Circles, CSAT Labels, CSAT Airlines
The average satisfaction score is 7.9, down 0.2% versus the previous month. Global Star, Atlantic Express and SkyConnect Airways all score 7.9 and Pacific Wings 7.8.

Top Destinations
The top flight destinations in North America: New York with 278 flights, then Toronto (69), Vancouver (58), Boston (56) and Chicago (46).

Main Flight Times
A heat map of flights by month and day of the week; the darkest cells are the busiest, and the labelled low and high are 201 and 333 flights.

Aircraft Utilization
Completed flights and average load factor by aircraft type, each compared with the previous month: the B787 flew the most (317 flights) with the highest load factor (91.1%), followed by the B777 (315 flights, 90.7%), the A330 (293, 89.6%), the B737 (289, 90.3%), the A320 (281, 90.0%) and the A350 (280, 90.4%).

Mishandling, Baggage Airlines
The flights-with-baggage-mishandling indicator stands at 78.7% overall; by airline it is 86.7% for Pacific Wings, 83.5% for Atlantic Express, 79.5% for Global Star and 77.3% for SkyConnect Airways.

Years, Months, Selected Region, Airline Navigation, Logged in, Hide Guidelines, Show Guidelines
The dashboard's controls: the year and month buttons, the region drop-down, the navigation menu to the airline, flight and fleet pages, the login greeting and the guideline toggles. They carry no measures of their own.
